posts.community: SKF India - Bearing fruits of MNC Parentage & Industrialization
posts.text: SKF India posted excellent results posting 27% sales growth (588 cr) and profits at 62 cr. Normalized for whole year we are looking at a profit of 250 crore and PE of 30 which is in line with NRB bearings but cheaper than Schaeffer and Timken. Anyone tracking this. Looks like analysts have dropped coverage due to demerger which in turn led to messy numbers for last year. But mutual funds seems to continue backing the stock as holding has gone up from 23.3% to 24.3% over last one year.
